battle.name: 波立戰爭
battle.brief: 在戰爭列表所列的波立戰爭中，波軍自1920年沿波蘭東境反擊蘇俄紅軍，科韋爾與周邊地區成為初期戰線。1865年列裝的英國蒸汽鐵甲艦（Steam ironclad）代表早期鐵甲艦隊的遠洋部署能力，可用於航線保護與海上封鎖，但並非本場陸戰的核心裝備。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦屬英國海軍早期鐵甲艦隊，以蒸汽動力執行遠洋巡航，負責殖民地航線保護、海上封鎖與岸轟，是海軍由風帆艦隊轉向蒸汽艦隊的重要裝備。

countries: 「波立戰爭」在這裡指1920年至1921年的波蘭－蘇俄戰爭，主要交戰國是波蘭第二共和國與俄羅斯蘇維埃聯邦社會主義共和國；後者到1922年才成為蘇聯，因此不能把紅軍直接寫成蘇聯軍。波蘭的主要盟友是西烏克蘭人民共和國及其加利西亞軍，西白俄羅斯游擊隊也曾在配合波軍作戰的框架下活動。法國與英國向波蘭提供武器、經費、軍事使團和顧問，並派有個別志願人員，但兩國並未以國家身分投入主要戰線。蘇俄紅軍則由俄羅斯、白俄羅斯、烏克蘭及其他受其管轄地區的人員組成，與波軍及烏克蘭盟軍在東加利西亞、沃里尼亞、西白俄羅斯和維斯瓦河中下游交戰。戰爭由1920年2月14日紅軍發動大規模攻勢開始，至1921年3月18日《里加條約》簽署、前線停止大規模戰鬥而告一段落。
countriesEn: The Polish-Soviet War referred to here was fought principally between the Second Polish Republic and the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. The latter did not become the Soviet Union until 1922, so the Red Army should not be described as Soviet for 1920. Poland’s principal ally was the West Ukrainian People’s Republic and its Galician Army, while Belarusian partisan formations also operated in cooperation with Polish forces. France and Britain supplied Poland with weapons, funds, military missions, advisers, and individual volunteers, but neither state entered the principal front as an official belligerent. The Red Army drew personnel from Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, and other territories under Soviet authority and fought Polish and Ukrainian forces in East Galicia, Volhynia, western Belarus, and the middle and lower Vistula. The major Soviet offensive began on 14 February 1920; large-scale fighting ended when the Treaty of Riga was signed on 18 March 1921.
people: 波軍最高指揮者是約瑟夫·畢蘇斯基，他既是國家元首，也在1920年5月20日接管東線的直接軍事指揮，親自主持七月反攻與八月維斯瓦河戰役。愛德華·雷茲－希米格利率領南線軍團，後來負責東邊防戰區；瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科爾斯基在華沙戰役中指揮北方集團，阻止蘇軍騎兵越過維斯瓦河向華沙後方迂迴；塔德烏什·庫切巴指揮中央預備集團及騎兵部隊，在突破維普爾河後形成最重要的高速追擊。安德烈斯在戰役後期接掌東南軍級集群，參與冬季戰線與最後防務。蘇軍方面，謝爾蓋·卡梅涅夫是紅軍最高統帥，米哈伊爾·圖哈切夫斯基先統率第四軍及西南戰線，後來負責三月最後攻勢；伊薩克·拉比諾維奇指揮第三軍，約納·亞基爾先統率第三步兵軍、後接掌第三軍，紅軍騎兵則由布瓊尼、拉舍維奇等高級指揮官調度。烏克蘭盟軍最高政治領袖西蒙·彼得留拉仍保持流亡政府身分，其部隊則由加利西亞軍指揮官率領。
peopleEn: Józef Piłsudski was Poland’s head of state and supreme commander. On 20 May 1920 he assumed direct operational command of the eastern front and personally directed the July counteroffensive and the Battle of the Vistula. Edward Rydz-Śmigły commanded the southern group of armies and later the eastern defensive front. Władysław Sikorski led the northern group during the Warsaw campaign and checked the Soviet cavalry attempt to cross the Vistula and turn the Polish rear. Tadeusz Kutrzeba commanded the central reserve and cavalry forces, and his exploitation after the Wieprz crossing produced the campaign’s fastest decisive advance. Władysław Anders took charge of a southeastern army group late in the war and participated in the winter front and final defensive operations. On the Soviet side, Sergey Kamenev was commander in chief of the Red Army. Mikhail Tukhachevsky commanded the Fourth Army and Southwestern Front before leading the final March offensive; Isaak Rabinovich commanded the Third Army; Iona Yakir led the Third Rifle Corps and later the Third Army; and senior cavalry commanders such as Semyon Budyonny and Mikhail Lashevich directed mounted formations. Simon Petliura remained the political head of the allied Ukrainian government in exile, while Galician Army commanders led the Ukrainian troops in the field.
kits: 雙方裝備並不單一。波軍步兵主要使用法國勒貝爾1886式步槍、1919式短槍，並有奧地利製斯特爾M1895步槍、英國短彈匣李－恩菲爾德Mk III步槍及繳獲的莫辛－納甘M1891/30步槍；機槍包括7.92毫米Maxim MG08/15、7.62毫米Maxim M1910和8毫米Hotchkiss Mle 1914。砲兵以法國75毫米 modèle 1897野戰砲為核心，配有105毫米Schneider mle 1913砲及奧地利30.5厘米M.11榴彈砲，常見炮彈口徑分別為7.5×54毫米與105×45毫米。波蘭裝甲部隊使用Renault FT-17輕戰車，其武器為37毫米SA 18砲與7.9毫米Reibel機槍；空軍則運用Nieuport 27、SPAD XIII、Ansaldo SVA、Bristol F.2B及Avro 504等作戰與偵察機。蘇軍以莫辛－納甘步槍、M1910式Maxim機槍、76.2毫米1902式野戰砲、122毫米1910式榴彈砲和120毫米Schneider砲為主，並大量使用裝甲列車，亦有MS-1輕戰車。雙方都依賴標準與寬軌鐵路、載重汽車、馬車、輕便鐵路、戰地電話和信號旗；波軍由西側港口經鐵路送入勒貝爾8×32毫米R、.303英吋及7.92、7.62毫米等不同口徑彈藥，野戰砲與機槍另以彈藥箱分批補充。
kitsEn: Equipment on both sides was mixed. Polish infantry used the French Lebel Model 1886 rifle and Model 1919 short carbine, the Austro-Hungarian Steyr M1895, the British Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III, and captured Mosin-Nagant M1891/30 rifles. Machine guns included the 7.92 mm Maxim MG08/15, 7.62 mm Maxim M1910, and 8 mm Hotchkiss Mle 1914. Artillery was built around the French 75 mm modèle 1897 field gun, supplemented by the 105 mm Schneider mle 1913 and Austro-Hungarian 30.5 cm M.11 howitzer, with common ammunition dimensions of 7.5 by 54 mm and 105 by 45 mm. Polish armored units operated Renault FT-17 light tanks armed with a 37 mm SA 18 gun and a 7.9 mm Reibel machine gun. The air service flew Nieuport 27, SPAD XIII, Ansaldo SVA, Bristol F.2B, and Avro 504 aircraft in combat and reconnaissance roles. Soviet forces relied on Mosin-Nagant rifles, Model 1910 Maxim machine guns, 76.2 mm Model 1902 field guns, 122 mm Model 1910 howitzers, and 120 mm Schneider guns, while making extensive use of armored trains and some MS-1 light tanks. Both armies depended on standard- and broad-gauge railways, trucks, horse-drawn wagons, light rails, field telephones, and signal flags. Polish supplies came through western ports and were distributed in several calibers, including Lebel 8 by 32 mmR, .303 inch, 7.92 mm, and 7.62 mm ammunition, with field-gun and machine-gun ammunition replenished in separate loads.
tactics: 波軍的戰役方法並非始終一致。最初以縱深阻滯和保留預備隊為主，後來轉為集中兵力的攻勢作戰，並重視砲兵、騎兵、裝甲兵與工兵的協同；這種轉變在熱日林和維普爾河戰役中最明顯。華沙反攻前，畢蘇斯基讓南線攻勢兼具牽制作用，使紅軍指揮官無法判斷波軍真正主攻方向，再由北方集團限制騎兵迂迴，由中央集團集中突破。騎兵突破後沒有停在奪取陣地，而以連續奔襲追擊撤退縱隊，使紅軍後方指揮與道路運輸受到直接壓力。蘇軍的戰術則兼具總量優勢與集中突擊，但過早展開的縱深部隊經常和指揮中心、火砲支援及後方鐵路脫節；裝甲列車可依鐵路迅速轉移並提供火力，離開鐵路後則難以追上機動作戰。冬季厚雪限制糧秣和炮彈輸送，春季融雪又破壞道路，因此蘇軍每次攻勢都必須先解決戰術突破後的補給。波軍最後依托東邊防線，運用預備隊封鎖缺口，再以反擊奪取紅軍炮位與車列，顯示固定陣地與機動反擊可以互相配合。
tacticsEn: Polish methods changed considerably during the campaign. The opening phase emphasized delaying actions, depth, and preservation of reserves. Later operations concentrated force for counteroffensives and combined artillery, cavalry, armored troops, and engineers. This transition was clearest at Żyrzyn and along the Wieprz. Before the Warsaw counteroffensive, Piłsudski made the southern effort perform a fixing function so that Soviet commanders could not identify the real Polish axis of attack. The northern group restricted the cavalry envelopment, while the central group concentrated for the decisive penetration. After the cavalry breakout, the mounted troops did not merely occupy captured ground; they pursued the withdrawing columns continuously and placed direct pressure on the Soviet rear command and road transport. Soviet tactics combined mass with concentrated assault, but deeply deployed formations frequently lost contact with their command centers, artillery support, and rear railways. Armored trains could move rapidly along the rails and provide fire support, but once they left the track they could not keep pace with mobile operations. Deep winter snow restricted the movement of food and artillery ammunition, while the spring thaw damaged roads, forcing the Red Army to solve the supply problem each time it achieved a tactical breakthrough. The final Polish defense combined the eastern fortified line, reserves sealing gaps, and counterattacks recovering Soviet guns and supply vehicles, showing how a fixed front could support mobile counteroffensives.
data: 戰役全期可按四個階段觀察。第一階段是1920年2月至5月的戰略退卻與動員：紅軍突破丹布羅瓦、科韋爾後占領大片東加利西亞和沃里西亞，波軍放棄部分突出部，把師級部隊調往盧布林、華沙與維斯瓦河。第二階段是5月至8月的攻勢準備與熱日林戰役，畢蘇斯基集中二十餘個步兵師及騎兵、砲兵、裝甲和工兵單位，紅軍則以第四、第三等步兵軍配合騎兵縱隊反覆轉向。第三階段是8月至10月的維斯瓦河戰役及追擊，紅軍第四軍與第四騎兵軍在華沙外圍受挫，波軍沿維普爾河、沃里尼亞鐵路和布格河方向追擊，奪回日托米爾等節點。第四階段是11月至翌年3月的冬季攻防與停戰，蘇軍因西方側翼和東加利西亞未能得手而退，轉向沃里尼亞再攻，卻在後勤、戰損及指揮分散下喪失突破能力。軍隊編制由師、旅、營、連構成，騎兵師、裝甲團、工兵旅和鐵路repair units 配合；前線供應通常經軍用鐵路送至師屬炮兵陣地，再以馬車分送步兵連與機槍陣位。
dataEn: The campaign can be divided into four phases. The first, from February to May 1920, was a strategic withdrawal accompanied by mobilization. After breaking through at Dąbrowa and Kowel, the Red Army occupied substantial parts of East Galicia and Polesie. Poland abandoned exposed positions and shifted divisional formations toward Lublin, Warsaw, and the Vistula. The second phase, from May to August, covered preparation for the counteroffensive and the fighting at Żyrzyn. Piłsudski concentrated more than twenty infantry divisions together with cavalry, artillery, armored, and engineer formations, while the Soviet side repeatedly turned its Third and Fourth rifle armies and mounted columns. The third phase, from August through October, comprised the Vistula campaign and the pursuit. The Soviet Fourth and Fourth Cavalry Armies were checked outside Warsaw, and Polish forces advanced along the Wieprz, the Volhynian railways, and toward the Bug, recovering Zhitomir and other rail centers. The fourth phase, from November through March, consisted of winter operations and the armistice. After failing to turn the Polish western flank and retain East Galicia, Soviet forces withdrew and shifted their offensive into Volhynia, but their ability to break through deteriorated through losses, logistical strain, and dispersed command. Army organization rested on divisions, brigades, regiments, battalions, and companies, supported by cavalry divisions, armored regiments, engineer brigades, and railway-repair units. Supplies normally moved by military rail to divisional artillery positions and were then distributed by wagon to infantry companies and machine-gun positions.
cause: 戰爭的根本背景是第一次世界大戰後俄羅斯、德國及奧匈帝國秩序崩潰，波蘭、烏克蘭、白俄羅斯與蘇俄尚未形成穩定邊界。波蘭在協約國承認與援助下重建國家，並取得中歐與東歐之間的戰略位置；蘇俄則面臨內戰、白俄羅斯與烏克蘭游擊運動、紅軍補充和後方運輸等壓力。紅軍向西推進，既是軍事擴張，也是蘇俄企圖建立可輸出革命秩序的邊界。波蘭不能接受首都、維斯瓦河工業帶與鐵路落入紅軍控制，並希望利用彼得留拉政權及加利西亞軍作為 eastern buffer。這一結構使邊界安全、區域政治控制與資源利益互相重疊；1920年2月紅軍沿多處同時進攻後，原本可由局部停戰處理的爭議迅速演變成全國存亡與東境重劃的戰爭。
causeEn: The fundamental background was the collapse of the Russian, German, and Austro-Hungarian order after the First World War, leaving no settled frontier among Poland, Ukraine, Belarus, and Soviet Russia. Poland rebuilt its state with Entente recognition and assistance, acquiring a strategic position between central and eastern Europe. Soviet Russia, meanwhile, faced civil war, Belarusian and Ukrainian partisan activity, the difficulty of replenishing the Red Army, and strains on rear transport. The westward drive was both a military expansion and an attempt to establish a border from which a revolutionary order might be projected. Poland could not accept Red Army control of Warsaw, the industrial belt along the Vistula, and the railway network, and it sought to use Petliura’s government and the Galician Army as an eastern buffer. Strategic security, regional political influence, and access to resources consequently reinforced one another. When the Red Army attacked along several axes in February 1920, disputes that might have been settled by a local armistice became a struggle over national survival and the future eastern frontier.
impact: 1920年的勝負首先改變了東歐的軍力配置。紅軍在華沙方向受挫後放棄深入波蘭，蘇俄得以保住基輔與大部分烏克蘭、白俄羅斯領土，但也失去迅速建立西部革命邊界的機會；波蘭則從威脅下恢復首都與交通線，取得東加利西亞及部分西烏克蘭、西白俄羅斯土地，取得比戰前更有利的防禦縱深。軍事上，蘇軍總量充足但補給與指揮集中不足的問題受到廣泛檢討，戰後更重視步兵、砲兵、裝甲和後勤的協同；波軍則證明以鐵路集結、騎兵追擊與預備隊反擊結合，可以彌補兵力與火力的差距。畢蘇斯基及一批前線指揮官因此獲得聲望，這份軍事威望與退役軍人網絡後來成為1926年五月政變的重要資本。從更長期的戰略看，波蘭把國防重心移到維斯瓦河與新建東境，蘇俄則由軍事西進轉向鞏固國內秩序；但戰爭沒有消除波蘇邊界問題，條約劃定的線界在隨後二十年間仍反覆成為軍事計畫與外交爭議的對象。
impactEn: The outcome of 1920 first altered the military balance of eastern Europe. After the Red Army was checked in the Warsaw sector, it withdrew from deep penetration into Poland. Soviet Russia retained Kyiv and most of Ukraine and Belarus but lost the opportunity to establish a revolutionary western frontier quickly. Poland recovered its capital and transport routes, regained East Galicia and portions of western Ukraine and Belarus, and obtained a more defensible depth behind the Vistula and the new eastern border. Militarily, the evident weakness of Soviet mass formations in supply and command concentration prompted broad study of combined arms, logistics, and operational control. Poland demonstrated that railway concentration, mounted pursuit, and prepared reserve counterattacks could compensate for shortages in infantry and artillery. Piłsudski and other front-line commanders gained substantial prestige, and that military standing together with networks of retired officers later became an important resource in the May Coup of 1926. In the longer strategic term, Poland shifted its defense toward the Vistula and the new eastern frontier, while Soviet Russia moved from westward military expansion toward consolidation at home. The war did not remove the Polish-Soviet border dispute, however, and the line established by the treaty remained a recurring subject of military planning and diplomatic argument during the following two decades.
result: 最後結果由1921年3月的別列斯特琴科戰役與外交程序共同決定。波軍反擊摧毀紅軍第六軍一部的指揮核心，奪取火炮、機槍、彈藥和車列，使蘇軍無法繼續利用斯泰爾河方向突破；3月18日，波蘭與俄羅斯蘇維埃聯邦社會主義共和國、蘇維埃烏克蘭代表在里加簽訂條約，戰線停止大規模戰鬥。條約承認波蘭的主權與獨立，劃定波蘭和蘇俄、蘇維埃烏克蘭及蘇維埃白俄羅斯之間的新界線；波蘭取得東加利西亞及若干西部土地，蘇維埃烏克蘭保有基輔與其餘主要地區，蘇俄則重新建立通往莫斯科和明斯克的西部邊界。紅軍撤回蘇俄控制區，波軍則重新部署至新國境，交換俘虜並處理繳獲裝備。傷亡方面，各國官方彙表、交戰者回憶與後來研究對陣亡、重傷、失聯、被俘及病患的統計口徑並不一致，因此無法可靠列出精確總數；能確定的是雙方均有數萬量級的戰鬥損失，大量人員被俘，兩個月的戰役與冬季作戰也造成大量武器和馬匹耗損。這場戰爭以波軍保住國家並取得較有利邊界、蘇軍中止西進及紅軍退回東方而收束，並非任何一方的軍隊被完全消滅。
resultEn: The final outcome was determined by the fighting at Berestechko in March 1921 and the subsequent diplomatic settlement. A Polish counterattack broke the command structure of part of the Soviet Sixth Army and captured guns, machine guns, ammunition, and supply vehicles, preventing the Red Army from continuing its effort to break through along the Styr. On 18 March representatives of Poland, the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic, and Soviet Ukraine signed a treaty at Riga, and large-scale fighting stopped. The agreement recognized Polish sovereignty and independence and established a new frontier between Poland and Soviet Russia, Soviet Ukraine, and Soviet Byelorussia. Poland received East Galicia and portions of the western territories, while Soviet Ukraine retained Kyiv and most of its remaining territory, and Soviet Russia restored its western approach to Moscow and Minsk. The Red Army withdrew to Soviet-controlled territory, the Polish Army redeployed along the new border, and prisoners were exchanged while captured equipment was sorted and accounted for. Casualty totals cannot be stated reliably because official returns, participants’ accounts, and later studies counted deaths, serious wounds, missing personnel, prisoners, and sickness differently. What can be established is that both sides suffered losses measured in tens of thousands, that large numbers of personnel entered captivity, and that two months of major fighting and winter operations consumed substantial quantities of weapons and horses. The war ended with Poland preserving the state and obtaining a more favorable frontier, while Soviet Russia abandoned the westward offensive and the Red Army withdrew eastward; neither side had been completely destroyed.
